adosRun.note: Role and candidate-ownership assignment come from durable ADOS state, not a UI or evidence label. The durable record is .agent-workflow/runs/148-autonomous-company-operations-end-to-end/ados-run.json (gitignored, worktree-absolute paths). An allowlist of its stable identity fields is mirrored into the tracked, sanitized specs/148-autonomous-company-operations-end-to-end/ados-run.sanitized.json; absolute paths and volatile per-cycle lifecycle fields (status, nextStage, implementationFailure, implementationRecoveryAttempts, implementationRecoveryBlock) are deliberately excluded because committing this evidence advances HEAD and would immediately stale any frozen lifecycle snapshot. tools/agent-workflow/spec148RoleAssignmentEvidence.test.ts asserts the agentAssignment below is transcribed unchanged from ados-run.sanitized.json, and - when the durable file is present in the worktree - that the sanitized copy still matches durable ADOS state field-for-field across the allowlist. The real ADOS execution-path semantics (preparation validation, structured request, durable run status records) are additionally exercised by the real ExternalProjectAdosExecutionService in the deterministic harness.

acceptanceCriteriaMapping.note: References below distinguish the authoritative requirements doc's numbered sections (1-24, e.g. 'section 3' = Controlled E2E Test Project) from its separate, differently-numbered 'Acceptance Criteria' list (1-20, e.g. 'acceptance criterion 1' = One controlled autonomous project cycle is demonstrated end to end) - the two lists share numbers 1-20 for unrelated content, so this evidence always spells out which list it means. Two distinct levels appear below and must not be read as one contradicting the other: (1) verifiedCycleCompletion is the terminal state of the SIMULATED daily-proof project's autonomous chain under verification - the subject of acceptance criteria 1-9 and 12-17; it IS reached (adosExecutionRecordStatus: Completed). (2) externalSafetyBoundary/publicationResult is a separate, outer gate over THIS Spec 148 implementation candidate itself - whether the code change that provides the above verification has been reviewed and published - and is correctly pending at every implementation handoff (acceptance criteria 10, 11, 19, 20), never fabricated (section 18, Failure Visibility).
acceptanceCriteriaMapping.listReferenced: authoritative requirements doc's 'Acceptance Criteria' list (1-20), not its numbered sections (1-24)

verifiedCycleCompletion.note: Terminal state of the SIMULATED daily-proof project's autonomous chain (Spec147->145->141->146->144->142/138->ADOS execution boundary). Spec 144 authorizes STARTING one bounded execution through the Spec 142/138 bridge. The bridge does not chain into validate/review/publish/merge for that simulated task, and this is not a gap this evidence talks around: it is an invariant the durable run-status persistence schema enforces, proven by test, not merely observed. ExternalProjectAdosRunStatusTypes.ts types validationStarted/reviewStarted/repositoryMutationStarted/githubMutationStarted/publishStarted/mergeStarted/deployStarted as the literal `false` (a TypeScript compile-time bar against production code ever constructing one with `true`), and BrowserOfficeSessionService.ts's isExternalProjectAdosRunStatus (~L363-386) drops any run-status entry on save/restore round trip where they are not all false. AutonomousCompanyOperationsE2E.test.ts's Test X now exercises this directly: it tampers the exact run-status record this cycle produced with reviewStarted/publishStarted set true and asserts the round trip drops it, the same rejection BrowserOfficeSessionService.test.ts's 'ignores malformed persisted external ADOS run statuses' case proves generically. Triggering a real validate/review/publish run against a live repository for this simulated task would itself be the destructive/arbitrary repository work section 3 forbids.
verifiedCycleCompletion.source: real ExternalProjectAdosExecutionService execution/result status persisted into controller state
verifiedCycleCompletion.enforcementProvenById: src/features/city-view/scene/office/browser-session/BrowserOfficeSessionService.ts isExternalProjectAdosRunStatus (~L363-386); exercised by AutonomousCompanyOperationsE2E.test.ts Test X and BrowserOfficeSessionService.test.ts 'ignores malformed persisted external ADOS run statuses'

externalSafetyBoundary.note: A SEPARATE, outer level from verifiedCycleCompletion above: whether THIS Spec 148 implementation candidate (the code change providing the verification above) has itself been reviewed and published. Push, PR readiness, approval, merge, and remote deletion are human-only (execution policy; the same boundary Specs 142-147 declare) and are explicitly not performed by this implementer runtime, so every field below is correctly pending/false at implementation handoff, including this one - that is compliance with the execution policy, not an incomplete cycle. ADOS runs full configured validation and an independent Codex review against the exact candidate HEAD after every implementation handoff. This tracked artifact deliberately does not freeze a per-candidate validation result or review decision: committing it advances HEAD, so any frozen verdict is immediately stale. The live verdict lives in the durable sources named in shaAlignment.durableSources and is gated by tools/agent-workflow/reviewConvergence.js. Only publication/merge/deploy/GitHub mutation remain the human-only gate.

shaAlignment.note: Requirement 21 asks for candidate/validated/reviewed SHA 'where available' plus the exact-HEAD result. They are durably available in the sources below and resolved at validation/review time, not transcribed here: a SHA literal committed into a tracked file is stale the moment the commit lands (it changes HEAD). tools/agent-workflow/spec148RoleAssignmentEvidence.test.ts reads those durable sources when present and asserts candidate == validated == reviewed alignment from them; it also asserts the enforcement gate directly so the check holds in a clean checkout where the durable files are absent. candidate.json is written for the exact commit under test before validation runs, so unlike reviewed_sha (necessarily a prior cycle's record at the moment this suite executes, per the in-file pipeline-order comment) the candidate==exactHead leg has no circularity: the suite asserts durableCandidate.candidate_sha === `git rev-parse HEAD` unconditionally (no guard), and asserts validation left the worktree unmutated (head_before === head_after) unconditionally whenever a durable validation record exists.
shaAlignment.exactHeadInvariant: ADOS enforces candidateSha == validatedSha == reviewedSha == exact HEAD before publication via tools/agent-workflow/reviewConvergence.js computeConvergenceStatus (exactTargetMatch gate). validated == reviewed alignment is additionally cross-checked from candidate.json / validation-runtime.json / review-runtime.json when those durable files are present in the worktree.
shaAlignment.enforcementProvenById: tools/agent-workflow/reviewConvergence.js computeConvergenceStatus (exactTargetMatch gate); exercised by tools/agent-workflow/spec148RoleAssignmentEvidence.test.ts including stale-approval rejection, 'converges only when validated == reviewed == exact HEAD', and durable-source validated == reviewed cross-check

publicationResult: Blocked until ADOS records an Approved independent Codex review with validatedSha == reviewedSha == exact HEAD (tools/agent-workflow/reviewConvergence.js computeConvergenceStatus == CONVERGED). Concerns the Spec 148 candidate's own publication (externalSafetyBoundary), a separate outer gate from verifiedCycleCompletion above, which the chain test already demonstrates reached. Human-only gate; not reached at implementation handoff. This is a standing condition, not a per-candidate status snapshot.
